<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" />{{rh|CHA. X.|ACCORDING TO S. IOHN.|249}}</noinclude>of blinde men?

{{verse|chapter=10|verse=22}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''1. Mach. 4, 56. 59.''}}* And {{sup|‖}} the Dedication vvas in Hierusalem: and it vvas vvinter. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=23}}† {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel vpō Wenesday in Passion weeke.}}And {{sc|Iesvs}} vvalked in the temple, in Salomons porche. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=24}}† The Ievves therfore compassed him round about, and said to him, Hovv long doest thou hold our soule in suspense? if thou be {{sc|Christ}}, tel vs openly. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=25}}† {{sc|Iesvs}} answered them, I speake to you: and you beleeue not. the vvorkes that I doe in the name of my Father, they giue testimonie of me. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=26}}† but you doe not beleeue, because you are not of my sheepe. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=27}}† My sheepe heare my voice: and I knovv them, and they folovv me. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=28}}† And I giue them life euerlasting: and they shal not perish for euer, and no man shal plucke them out of my hand. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=29}}† {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ An other reading is, ''My father that hath giuen me, &c''.}}∷ My father, {{sup|‖}} that vvhich he hath giuen me, is greater then al: and no man can plucke them out of the hand of my father. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=30}}† I and the Father are c {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ c vnum.}}∷ one.

{{verse|chapter=10|verse=31}}† The Ievves tooke vp stones, to stone him. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=32}}† {{sc|Iesvs}} ansvvered them, Many good vvorkes I haue shewed you from my father, for vvhich of those vvorkes doe you stone me? {{verse|chapter=10|verse=33}}† The Iewes ansvvered him, For a good vvorke we stone the not, but for blasphemie, and because thou being a man, makest thy self God. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=34}}† {{sc|Iesvs}} ansvvered them, Is it not vvritten in your lavv, that ''I said, you are goddes''?{{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''Ps. 81, 6.''}} {{verse|chapter=10|verse=35}}† If he called them goddes, to vvhom the vvord of God vvas made, and the scripture can not be broken: {{verse|chapter=10|verse=36}}† vvhom the Father hath sanctified and sent into the vvorld, say you, That thou blasphemest, because I said I am the sonne of God? {{verse|chapter=10|verse=37}}† If I doe not the vvorkes of my father, beleeue me not. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=38}}† But if I doe, and if you vvil not beleeue me, beleeue the vvorkes: that you may knovv and beleeue that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.⊣ {{verse|chapter=10|verse=39}}† They sought therfore to apprehend him: and he vvent forth out of their handes.

{{verse|chapter=10|verse=40}}† and he vvent againe beyond Iordan into that place vvhere Iohn vvas baptizing first: and he taried there. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=41}}† and many came to him. and they said, That Iohn in deede did no signe. But al things vvhatsoeuer Iohn said of this man, vvere true. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=42}}† And many beleeued in him.
